purpose: start a project with an agreed purpose, scope, roles and first steps, so everyone begins with the same understanding
entry_criteria: A project manager and sponsor are named
Initial budget and time frame exist
procedure: Write a short charter: purpose, objectives, scope, exclusions, success measures and constraints.
Name the sponsor, project manager and team leads, and state who decides what.
List the stakeholders and how each will be kept informed.
Set up the working basics: repository, backlog, communication channels and meeting rhythm.
List the first risks, assumptions and dependencies, with owners.
Hold a kickoff, share the charter and get written acknowledgement from the sponsor.
acceptance_criteria: Roles and decision rights are named
Conditions of approval are carried into the plan

validation.check: check every approval condition from stage 9 appears in the plan with an owner
check the charter has a dated sponsor acknowledgement

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A charter for a data migration lists three objectives, excludes decommissioning the old system, names the sponsor as the budget decision maker, and carries over the approval condition about a security review.
